paragraphs.source_en: Once a man has become an animal that wears clothes, if he suddenly encounters a naked animal, he no longer recognizes it as human, but takes it for a beast. For that very reason Europeans, especially the northern Europeans, treat nude paintings and nude statues as beasts; that is, they regard them as beasts lower even than cats. What is that you say, that they are very beautiful? Beautiful they may be; one need only regard them as very beautiful beasts. If I say this, perhaps someone will ask whether I have ever seen the formal dress worn by Western ladies. Since I am a cat, I have never seen the formal dress of Western ladies, but I hear that they call an outfit exposing the breast, shoulders, and arms formal dress. What shamelessness! Before the fourteenth century their dress was not so ridiculous; they still wore the clothes ordinary people wore. Why, then, has their clothing now changed into something so vulgar, like that of circus performers? The reasons would take too long to explain, and I do not intend to go into them here. Those who know may know; those who do not know may simply remain ignorant. Leaving aside the history of such attire, at any rate, though at night they make this grotesque display and look pleased with themselves, inwardly they must retain a little human feeling; for once daylight comes, they hunch their shoulders, cover their arms, conceal their breasts, and leave no part of the body exposed. Nor is that all; they consider it a terrible disgrace even to show a single toe. From this one can see that the utterly mismatched function of what they call formal dress is quite enough to prove it the product of fools consulting with fools. If anyone objects to this, let him try going out into the street in broad daylight with breast, shoulders, and arms exposed. The same applies to the believers in nudity. If they truly believe nudity is the most beautiful thing, let them strip their daughters naked, and while they are about it, let them go naked themselves for a stroll in Ueno Park. What, they cannot do it? It is not that they cannot; it is that Westerners do not do it, and so they do not do it either, is it not? Is it not in fact the case that some people, wearing just such an utterly unreasonable formal dress, strut in and out of places like the Imperial Hotel? If one asks why they do this, the answer is perfectly simple: merely because foreigners dress that way, they dress that way too. Because Westerners are powerful, whether the imitation is forced or foolish, they feel uneasy unless they follow along. Roll yourself up before what is long, bend before what is strong, be crushed beneath what is heavy: such servility everywhere is surely rather stupid. If one says that such foolishness cannot be helped, then of course I will pardon it; but please do not suppose the Japanese are anything very splendid. The same is true even in scholarship, but as that has nothing to do with clothing, I shall say no more here.

units.source_en: Once a man has become an animal that wears clothes, if he suddenly encounters a naked animal, he no longer recognizes it as human, but takes it for a beast.
units.source_zh: 一旦成了穿衣服的动物以后，再突然碰上裸体动物，就不承认它是人，而是兽了。

units.source_en: For that very reason Europeans, especially the northern Europeans, treat nude paintings and nude statues as beasts; that is, they regard them as beasts lower even than cats.
units.source_zh: 正因为如此，所以欧洲人，特别是北边的欧洲人是将裸体画、裸体像当做兽来对待的，也就是说认为它是比猫还不如的兽。

units.source_en: What is that you say, that they are very beautiful?
units.source_zh: 您说什么美得很？

units.source_en: Beautiful they may be; one need only regard them as very beautiful beasts.
units.source_zh: 美就是美，将它看作是很美的兽就是了。

units.source_en: If I say this, perhaps someone will ask whether I have ever seen the formal dress worn by Western ladies.
units.source_zh: 我这样说，也许有人会问，你没有看见过西方妇女穿的礼服吗？

units.source_en: Since I am a cat, I have never seen the formal dress of Western ladies, but I hear that they call an outfit exposing the breast, shoulders, and arms formal dress.
units.source_zh: 因为我是猫儿，没有看见过西方妇女的礼服，但据我听说，她们把袒胸露臂的装束称作礼服。

units.source_en: What shamelessness!
units.source_zh: 真是恬不知耻！

units.source_en: Before the fourteenth century their dress was not so ridiculous; they still wore the clothes ordinary people wore. Why, then, has their clothing now changed into something so vulgar, like that of circus performers?

ja.t: ておった。それがなぜ、こんな
してきたのであろうか。

units.source_zh: 在十四世纪以前，她们的装束并没有这般滑稽，那时她们还是穿一般人穿的衣服，为什么现在她们的服装会转变成这样下流，和马戏班子演员一样了呢？

units.source_en: The reasons would take too long to explain, and I do not intend to go into them here.
units.source_zh: 这理由说来话长，我不想在这里多说。

units.source_en: Those who know may know; those who do not know may simply remain ignorant.

ja.t: をしておればよろしかろう。

units.source_zh: 知之者为知之，不知者为不知，也就算了。

units.source_en: Leaving aside the history of such attire, at any rate, though at night they make this grotesque display and look pleased with themselves, inwardly they must retain a little human feeling; for once daylight comes, they hunch their shoulders, cover their arms, conceal their breasts, and leave no part of the body exposed.

ja.t: らしいところもあると
み、どこもかしこもことごとく

units.source_zh: 她们这种装束的历史姑且不说，反正她们尽管在夜里做出这种丑态还自鸣得意，但在内心里毕竟还是保留了一些人味，所以一到白天，她们就缩肩藏臂，把胸部掩盖起来，身体的任何部位都不外露。

units.source_en: Nor is that all; they consider it a terrible disgrace even to show a single toe.
units.source_zh: 不但如此，而且她们认为即使露出一只脚趾，也是极其羞耻的。

units.source_en: From this one can see that the utterly mismatched function of what they call formal dress is quite enough to prove it the product of fools consulting with fools.
units.source_zh: 这样看来，她们的所谓礼服所起的牛唇不对马嘴的作用，足可以说明它是傻瓜在一起商量出来的产物。

units.source_en: If anyone objects to this, let him try going out into the street in broad daylight with breast, shoulders, and arms exposed.
units.source_zh: 如果有人对这种说法不服气，那不妨在大白天袒胸露臂到大街上去试一试！

units.source_en: The same applies to the believers in nudity.
units.source_zh: 对于裸体信奉者也是如此。

units.source_en: If they truly believe nudity is the most beautiful thing, let them strip their daughters naked, and while they are about it, let them go naked themselves for a stroll in Ueno Park.
units.source_zh: 如果他们真认为裸体最美，不妨让他们的女儿脱光，顺便自己也光着身子在上野公园散散步。

units.source_en: What, they cannot do it?
units.source_zh: 什么，做不到？

units.source_en: It is not that they cannot; it is that Westerners do not do it, and so they do not do it either, is it not?
units.source_zh: 并不是做不到，而是西方人不那样做，所以自己也就不做吧？

units.source_en: Is it not in fact the case that some people, wearing just such an utterly unreasonable formal dress, strut in and out of places like the Imperial Hotel?
units.source_zh: 现实情况难道不是有人就穿着这样极不合理的礼服趾高气扬出入于帝国饭店吗？

units.source_en: If one asks why they do this, the answer is perfectly simple: merely because foreigners dress that way, they dress that way too.
units.source_zh: 如果问她们为什么要这样，问题简单得很，只是因为洋人这样穿，所以她们才这样穿罢了。

units.source_en: Because Westerners are powerful, whether the imitation is forced or foolish, they feel uneasy unless they follow along.
units.source_zh: 因为西方人势力强大，所以不管是硬去模仿，还是出于闹市，总之不跟着学就感到不舒服。

units.source_en: Roll yourself up before what is long, bend before what is strong, be crushed beneath what is heavy: such servility everywhere is surely rather stupid.
units.source_zh: 在人屋檐下嘛，快去平身低头吧，对强者认输吧，对压力屈服吧，这种处处奴颜婢膝未免太蠢了吧。

units.source_en: If one says that such foolishness cannot be helped, then of course I will pardon it; but please do not suppose the Japanese are anything very splendid.
units.source_zh: 如果说是因为不得已而干这种蠢事，当然可以原谅，不过，请不要认为日本人很了不起。

units.source_en: The same is true even in scholarship, but as that has nothing to do with clothing, I shall say no more here.
units.source_zh: 在做学问上，又何尝不是如此，不过这和服装无关，这里就不多讲了。

paragraphs.source_zh: 一旦成了穿衣服的动物以后，再突然碰上裸体动物，就不承认它是人，而是兽了。正因为如此，所以欧洲人，特别是北边的欧洲人是将裸体画、裸体像当做兽来对待的，也就是说认为它是比猫还不如的兽。您说什么美得很？美就是美，将它看作是很美的兽就是了。我这样说，也许有人会问，你没有看见过西方妇女穿的礼服吗？因为我是猫儿，没有看见过西方妇女的礼服，但据我听说，她们把袒胸露臂的装束称作礼服。真是恬不知耻！在十四世纪以前，她们的装束并没有这般滑稽，那时她们还是穿一般人穿的衣服，为什么现在她们的服装会转变成这样下流，和马戏班子演员一样了呢？这理由说来话长，我不想在这里多说。知之者为知之，不知者为不知，也就算了。她们这种装束的历史姑且不说，反正她们尽管在夜里做出这种丑态还自鸣得意，但在内心里毕竟还是保留了一些人味，所以一到白天，她们就缩肩藏臂，把胸部掩盖起来，身体的任何部位都不外露。不但如此，而且她们认为即使露出一只脚趾，也是极其羞耻的。这样看来，她们的所谓礼服所起的牛唇不对马嘴的作用，足可以说明它是傻瓜在一起商量出来的产物。如果有人对这种说法不服气，那不妨在大白天袒胸露臂到大街上去试一试！对于裸体信奉者也是如此。如果他们真认为裸体最美，不妨让他们的女儿脱光，顺便自己也光着身子在上野公园散散步。什么，做不到？并不是做不到，而是西方人不那样做，所以自己也就不做吧？现实情况难道不是有人就穿着这样极不合理的礼服趾高气扬出入于帝国饭店吗？如果问她们为什么要这样，问题简单得很，只是因为洋人这样穿，所以她们才这样穿罢了。因为西方人势力强大，所以不管是硬去模仿，还是出于闹市，总之不跟着学就感到不舒服。在人屋檐下嘛，快去平身低头吧，对强者认输吧，对压力屈服吧，这种处处奴颜婢膝未免太蠢了吧。如果说是因为不得已而干这种蠢事，当然可以原谅，不过，请不要认为日本人很了不起。在做学问上，又何尝不是如此，不过这和服装无关，这里就不多讲了。
